full_judgment: 4. The case of the pre-emptee-petitioner is that without cause of action the case is bad for defect of parties, barred by limitation and the case land along with other lands originally belonged to three brothers, namely Bhejal Mondal, Sharat Mondal and Bharat Mondal in equal shares and SA Khatian No. 34 was correctly prepared and finally published in their names. Bhejal Mondal died leaving behind one daughter named Laxibala Bhoumik as his sole heir. Thereafter Bharat Mondal died behind his brother Sharat Mondal to succeed his estate and then Sharat Mondal died leaving behind his widow and the preemptee as his heirs. Out of necessity for money, the mother of the pre-emptee mortgaged 37 decimals of land from the case jote to Amullya Sarker and Bijoy Krishna Sarker by a registered deed of patta and subsequently, SA record was prepared in the name of the said Amullya Sarker and Bijoy Krishna Sarker. Although the mortgage money was repaid, a redemption deed could not be executed due to financial crisis of the pre-emptee and his mother. The SA Khatian prepared and published in the name of Amullya Sarker and Bijoy Krishna Sarker is erroneous and the pre-emptee had no knowledge about the said khatian. The pre-emptee is in possession of 49 decimals of land in the case jote by inheritance and as such he is a co-sharer in the same. The pre-emptor had full knowledge about the impugned sale and that he has no necessity to pre-empt the case land and thereof, the application for pre-emption is liable to be dismissed.
